author: NeonRei
body:
Spend at least one hour a day killing mobs with affinity candle, XP boost, and all that jazz. But despite that I find this spell just decharges a lot faster than I think it used to.

Kind of notice this issue for about 3 weeks now. Maybe the mobs I'm killing are harder and therefore I'm killing less?

I just can't quite figure out what the deal is with it. I'm about to give up on sorrow. (灬º‿º灬)♡

author: SkyralCakeSlayer
body: Give up on sorrow. You're t10 right, why keep using a t5/t6 spell? You have much better available to you, like the fey spells you get from heretic or the multi-element II (multi-spark II for example) spells from omni.  Find transference 3 from an arcanist, that's a great spell

author: 1nc0mp3t3nc3
body:
Yeah, as someone who crossed over into Deity over the weekend, I find 5 days of the week, Sorrow is the most powerful spell. Day 6, it still goes strong, but on day 7 it's starts to plummet.

It's all to do with what kinds of creatures you kill. You want to target beasts, or animals as much as possible. Do hard mode gauntlets and  keep killing. I haven't found a spell that's suitably powerful enough to replace Sorrow III yet.
